Everything else was rated good. We are sorry for the confusion. On the dog flap, we are checking with the tenant whether any permission was given and will tell you what they say. On the spare front door key and the lock change, we are asking the tenant when and why the lock was changed and who holds keys, and will come back to you. As the name on your email differs from the landlord name we hold, please confirm you are the landlord or acting for them. You will hear from us by 22 Feb.

questions: Our inspection noted a dog flap in the back door. Did you get the landlord's permission before it was fitted, and if so can you send us the written agreement?
Has the front door lock been changed? If so, when, and who has the spare key(s)?
Please remove the command-strip stickers on the Bedroom 1 wall by the window and make good.
arguments.why: The landlord has raised an unapproved dog flap and a spare key after a lock change; we need the tenant's account before replying fully.
